name: @pemo/management-web
description: PEMO management web shell. Five read surfaces. Fixture corpus by default; a live client exists for GET /scope and GET /properties/tree and can be switched on.

scripts.generate: node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-tokens.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-property-tree.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-corpus.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-notice-reasons.ts && node --experimental-strip-types tool/generate-style-4s.ts
scripts.test: pnpm run test:node && pnpm run test:browser

//stack: Ruled by the Product Owner after the UI-019-ST step 1 proposal. React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript, no component library, node:test for logic and Playwright for the browser. The runtime shipped to a browser is react, react-dom and scheduler — three packages, and the complete list.
//no-component-library: MUI costs +80 runtime packages against a design-system section (v2.0 §12) that is Proposed rather than Accepted, and §12.1 warns about MUI X licensing on exactly the dense grids this surface is made of. Five screens of tables and forms are what semantic HTML does best.
//no-vitest-no-jsdom: jsdom has no layout engine, so a suite asserting Traditional Chinese renders correctly in dense table cells cannot fail for the right reason and cannot detect that it has no layout at all — UI-011-ST F6 moved from the transport to the harness. Playwright runs a real Chromium and costs 4 packages against jsdom's 58: the higher-fidelity option is also the cheaper one.
//no-plugin-react: @vitejs/plugin-react costs 48 packages, almost all Babel, and buys Fast Refresh. A fixture-rendered app does not need hot reload. Vite's esbuild handles JSX via esbuild.jsx in vite.config.ts.
//no-analytics: No runtime analytics, crash reporting or attribution SDK. This is a standing project rule, not a PID restriction, and test/deps/no-analytics-sdk.test.ts fails the build if the runtime dependency set ever grows beyond the allowlist.
//font-dependency: This app REQUIRES a Traditional Chinese font on the host — fonts-noto-cjk on Debian/Ubuntu. Without one every Chinese character renders as tofu, and tofu has a perfectly reasonable advance width, so a width-based typography assertion passes while measuring nothing. See README and UI-019-ST finding F3. `pnpm run check:fonts` decides whether a host is capable; the same check runs first in the browser suite and blocks it.
//generated-sources: src/**/*.g.ts and src/**/*.g.css are generated by tool/ and committed. Regenerate-and-compare tests fail on a stale generated file. Never hand-edit them. UI-054 added src/data/notice-reasons.g.ts, generated from packages/api-contracts/notice-reasons.json.
